messages:
Taylor: Heads-up — planning a blue->green ramp for router-8 in the 02:00 UTC change window. Target rollout: green at 30% -> 60% -> 100% over ~20m, then observe for 40m. Pin release tag v1.4.2 (commit abc1234).

deploy-bot: Scheduled shift queued. Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00:00 UTC -> 03:00:00 UTC. Playbook: /ops/playbooks/router-shift.md.

Alex: Quick Q — do we need a KV cache flush or do we rely on prefix caching? I worry about stale session routing.

Maya: No full flush. We'll prime green with a warmup tracer for 5m at 30% to populate KV. Session affinity remains cookie-based; set cookie TTL to 5m during ramp: `cookie.ttl=300s`.

OpsRunner: Rollback criteria proposed: p95 latency > 220ms sustained for 5m OR error rate (5xx) > 0.5% for 3m OR request drop rate spikes > 1%. If triggered, immediate rollback to blue 100% + drain green.

Saanvi: I'll wire an alert to #eng-oncall and create a temporary Grafana panel for the shift (link will be posted once done). Also enabling slow-request traces for the ramp.

Alex: What exact API call will we use to adjust weights? Pls paste snippet so oncall can run quickly.

Maya: Use this: `curl -X POST https://router-admin.internal/v1/weights -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' -d '{"target":"router-8","green":30}'` then repeat with 60/100. After final step run: `curl -X POST https://router-admin.internal/v1/drain -d '{"target":"blue","grace":300}'` to start graceful drain.

Taylor: During the 30->60 step we'll run a smoke set against green: `scripts/smoke.sh --target router-8 --profile payment-flow` — will post results inline.

deploy-bot: Reminder: enable fallback policy `fallback.model=blue-compat` in routing config so requests silently fallback to blue on timeout.

OpsRunner: Note — if we see a sustained 5xx pattern only for a single endpoint, we can use per-route tilt (soft isolate) instead of full rollback. Decision matrix: endpoint-only -> per-route isolate, multi-endpoint -> full rollback.

Saanvi: Grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/shift/blue-green-router-8 (live panel added). Alerts: #oncall ping on p95 & 5xx.

Alex: lgtm. I'll be on standby for manual weight changes and to run the drain command if needed.

Taylor: Ok starting warmup at 01:55 UTC with 30% probe. Will post smoke logs. :loud_sound:

deploy-bot: Shift initiated by Taylor at 2026-03-22T01:55:00Z — green=30%. Current status: probing.

Taylor: Smoke: payment-flow OK (200/200); avg p95=95ms. No anomalies yet.

Maya: Proceed to 60% in 5m assuming no alerts. Keep cookie.ttl and fallback enabled.

OpsRunner: If alert fires during 60% hold, recommended immediate step: set green->0 and run drain rollback command: `curl -X POST https://router-admin.internal/v1/weights -d '{"target":"router-8","green":0}'` then `curl -X POST https://router-admin.internal/v1/drain -d '{"target":"green","grace":180}'`.

Taylor: Copy. Will update thread with go/no-go at each step.

deploy-bot: Awaiting manual confirmations for 60% and 100% steps. Good luck! :rocket:
